commit_message:
new: [statistics] Add object relation usage statistics

Statistics objectRelationUsage prints, per object template, the relations
of the latest template version that are in use, ordered by the number of
objects populating them (ties broken by attribute count, then name).

Objects of every template version count towards the latest one. They are
matched by template UUID, case-insensitively, so renamed templates are
included. Deleted objects and attributes are ignored, and relations that
the latest version no longer has are left out.

Objects are processed in id-range chunks so that memory and per-query work
stay bounded on large instances. The JSON goes to stdout, progress to
stderr.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
